summary: Creating a Pipedrive OAuth app starts in Developer Hub with a sandbox account, an app name, and a callback URL. Private apps can be installed and tested right away, but each user must install individually and sandbox data is separate from production. Public Marketplace listing is blocked until the app passes review, which requires agreeing to the Developer Partner Agreement, providing test account details, and confirming your email address.

steps.title: Create a developer sandbox account
steps.detail: Sign up for a developer sandbox account in Pipedrive.

steps.title: Open Developer Hub and create an app
steps.detail: Log in to Developer Hub on your developer sandbox account, click “Create an app”, choose public or private, and fill in App name and OAuth Callback URL.

steps.title: Get client_id and client_secret
steps.detail: After saving, open the OAuth & access scopes tab and copy the client_id and client_secret.

steps.title: Set OAuth scopes and callback URL
steps.detail: In the OAuth & access scopes tab, select the access scopes your app needs and ensure the callback URL exactly matches the one your app will use; only one callback URL is allowed per app.

steps.title: Install and test in sandbox
steps.detail: Click “Install & test” in Developer Hub and complete the OAuth confirmation dialog to install the app on your sandbox account. Remember that sandbox data is separate from production and each user must install individually.

steps.title: Prepare public app listing fields
steps.detail: Fill in Website URL, Terms of Service URL, and Privacy Policy URL in Developer Hub.

steps.title: Submit app for review
steps.detail: Agree to the Pipedrive Developer Partner Agreement, provide test account information for the Marketplace team, confirm your email address, and click “Send to review”. The app status will change to “In review”.

blockers.symptom: App cannot be published or remains private
blockers.fix: Submit the app for the app approval process and confirm your email address; private apps are never published in the Marketplace.

blockers.symptom: Invalid redirect URL error during OAuth
blockers.fix: Make sure the redirect URL given to the user exactly matches the callback URL defined in Developer Hub.

blockers.symptom: client_id cannot be changed for an existing app
blockers.fix: Create a new app if a new client_id is required; the client_id cannot be refreshed or changed.

composio.notes: Check the toolkit page for managed auth. To bring your own app, register the redirect URI shown when you create a custom auth config.
